quote: Nee pakkana unna chinna kshanam kuda, naa roju motham gurthundipoye madhuramaina gnapakam avuthundi.
Nuvvu dooranga unna prathi roju, nee tho gadipina kshanalu naaku marinta daggaraga anipistayi.
Nee tho maatladina konni nimishalu, rojanta eduruchusina santhosham kanna ekkuvaga naa manasulo nilichipothayi.
Nuvvu emi cheppakapoyina, nee chupulo naaku ardhamaina prema chaala maatala kanna ekkuva cheppindi.
Chaala rojula tarvata ninnu choosina aa kshanam, madhyalo unna dooram motham oka nimishamlo karigipoyindi.
Nuvvu vellipoyina tarvata kuda, nee tho navvina aa chinna kshanalu naa manasuni inka navvistune unnayi.
Ninnu kalavaleni rojullo kuda, nee kosam eduruchoodadam naa manasuki oka chinna aasaga migilipoyindi.
Mana madhya maatlu taggina prathi saari, nee meeda unna naa prema maatram marinta mounanga perigindi.
Nuvvu naatho unna roju gurthosthe, ippudu unna ontaritnam kuda konchem takkuvaga anipistundi.
Nee peru vinipinchina prathi saari, marchipoyanani anukunna gnapakam malli naa mundu nilustundi.

Mana prema gurinchi evariki cheppakunda, nee kosam naa manasu dachukunna chinna chinna santhoshalu chaala unnayi.
Nuvvu eduruga nilabadi navvina aa kshanam, naa roju motham marchipoyela chesina oka chinna adbhutam.
